AnyVehicleOverhaul.Description: Every vehicle part mod in one: turbochargers and belt-driven superchargers with blow-off valves, wastegate, antilag and launch control, oil ports, air filters, intercoolers, a Dyno sensor and a 1-4 rotor rotary engine (AnyEngineParts); EngineSound's generated engine sounds; the GPS Sensor part; and AnyMoto's motorcycle fork, swingarm, seat, handlebars and Lean Assist. Replaces AnyEngineParts and AnyMoto; saves, settings and keybinds carry over. Each piece can be switched off in Mod Settings. Anymaker 0.2.0 only.
